output_check.method: Every file of each run directory compared byte for byte, with run.json, run.log's time columns and run-directory path, and index.tsv's elapsed_s masked.
output_check.reading: PASS with a qualification. All 8 runs with no tool timeout on either host (minepump and rg2) are identical, and 6 runs with timeouts are identical too. The 10 that differ all hit tool timeouts on both hosts, at different counts, so the divergence follows wall-clock budgets and not the compiler. No run differs without a timeout behind it.

seed_noise_factor.note: median |log(wall / cell median)| over the main campaign's finished runs of each family, all four arms, as a factor

wall_check.reading: FLAG, decided 2026-10-09: av1's seeds are kept. av1 runs about 9% slower than av2 on identical work. On minepump and rg2, whose seed noise is a factor of 1.04, av1 is 1.069 to 1.340 times slower on all 8 runs, outside the noise. On the long families the ratio sits inside their noise.

calibration.declared_contingency: PLAN.md: if the wall times disagree, av1's seeds are re-run on av2 and av3 before the wall-time figures are read. The disagreement is there (median ratio 1.089 av1/av2 on 14 identical runs, exact sign test p = 0.0129). Decision of 2026-10-09: av1's seeds 25-29 are kept as collected and are not re-run, and the paper does not state the host difference. Arm contrasts within a seed are unaffected, since all four arms of a seed ran on av1.

deviations.first_split_failed_to_build: The first split (av2 0-12, av3 13-25, av1 26-29) launched at 43ab6c2 on 2026-10-07. av3 042 and av1 007/008 failed at the build step three times that night; the queue log kept no compiler output. The same commit built cleanly on requeue at 13:27 on 2026-10-08. av2 ran seeds 0-12 alone overnight. The remaining 17 seeds were re-split at 953732b (13:40), which changes campaign.toml and PLAN.md only.
deviations.seed_13_restart: av3 042 was dequeued at 13:34:08 with seed 13 in flight. Its 21 finished rows stand at 43ab6c2, and the in-flight runs were re-run under the resume key at 953732b.
deviations.dequeue_16_57: At about 16:57 on 2026-10-08 the running search entries (av2 048, av3 045, av1 011) and the queued scoring entries (av2 049, av3 046, av1 012) were cancelled to move them behind 2026-10-08-fretish-rerun-analysis, and re-enqueued after it (av2 051, av3 048, av1 014). Runs in flight were killed and re-run under the resume key, which skips a run by its CSV key and never cleans its directory.

accumulator_double_count.what: The accumulator opens accumulated/index.tsv for append, so a killed run re-run into its own directory carries both attempts' rows behind two headers. score_curves.read_index skips the second header and counts every row. 63 of 3000 directories hold two attempts (seed 13: 15, 15: 2, 16: 4, 17: 10, 19: 16, 25: 3, 26: 13; av3 31, av2 16, av1 16; weighted/mrs 25, weighted/aurus 17, nsga2-apportion/mrs 13, nsga2-apportion/aurus 8).
accumulator_double_count.repeat_or_diverge: 50 of the 63 re-ran the killed attempt's rows as an exact prefix. 13 diverge, the killed attempt having reached different candidates under the same file names, and 1044 file names are indexed only by a killed attempt.
accumulator_double_count.not_affected: The results CSV, which reads the final repairs. maximal_solutions, maximal_ideal_solutions and the separation counts read each file once, and no members.tsv repeats a file. The 13 diverging runs' stale files can still sit in their antichains.
accumulator_double_count.status: Re-score enqueued 2026-10-09 as 2026-10-09-tlsf-rerun-rescore (branch campaign/tlsf-rerun-rescore, declaration at 80ba483) on av1, av2 and av3: the 63 runs only, each index read by its last attempt, at 2026-10-07-tlsf-rerun-scoring's maximality and recount settings, into curves-tlsf-rerun-rescore and separation-recount-tlsf-rerun-s0-rescore. The collected data stay as they are; the re-scored rows are spliced into new copies of the merged CSVs. Checked locally: the last-attempt read gives each run's distinct last-attempt count, and the old read gives the collected solutions value, on all 63.

deviations.av1_wall_contingency_not_run: The PLAN.md re-run of av1's seeds was not run, by decision of 2026-10-09. See calibration.declared_contingency.
deviations.launch_manifests_overwritten: Each re-enqueue rewrote the host's run manifest, so run-manifests/ holds the last launch per host: av2 051, av3 048, av1 014, and the calibration's 007.

caveats.aurus_rates_are_unfiltered: As in the paper-rerun: the well-separation screen's inputs did not survive, so AuRUS's per-family rates are unfiltered.
caveats.a_kill_is_not_symmetric: PEREDUR's accumulator flushes as it goes, so a killed run keeps its candidates; AuRUS writes its solutions at the end, so a killed run carries no verdict.
caveats.no_per_seed_pairing_with_the_paper_rerun: The engine changes since 57fcefb move the draw stream and the scores; comparisons with the paper-rerun are per arm and per family, and descriptive.
caveats.post_hoc: Every p-value here except the registered primary is post hoc.
